// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0xC8D1191E339AAF6E }

fn ml_streq(a: *const u8, b: *const u8) -> bool {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    loop {
        let (x, y) = unsafe { (*a.add(i), *b.add(i)) };
        if x != y { return false; }
        if x == 0 { return true; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_strout(src: *const u8, buf: *mut u8, cap: i32, needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    // Pass 1: count to the NUL, inclusive. `n` ends at >= 1 for every string.
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) };
        n += 1;
        if b == 0 { break; }
    }
    unsafe { *needed = n; }
    // Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short success (Q12). Nothing has been
    // written, and nothing will be.
    if cap < n { return -1; }
    // Pass 2: copy, terminator included.
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    while i < n {
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = *src.add(i as usize); }
        i += 1;
    }
    0
}

fn ml_fn_carrier_name(scac: *const u8, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(scac, b"UPSN\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"UPS Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"FDEG\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"FedEx Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"DHLE\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"DHL Express\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"SELF\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(scac, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    if ml_streq(scac, b"NONE\0".as_ptr()) {
        return ml_strout(b"\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    return 1;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_carrier_name(scac: *const u8, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_carrier_name(scac, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

fn ml_fn_carrier_label(scac: *const u8, tier: *mut i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if ml_streq(scac, b"UPSN\0".as_ptr()) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        return ml_strout(b"UPS Ground\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 0i32; }
    return ml_strout(b"Unassigned\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_carrier_label(scac: *const u8, tier: *mut i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_carrier_label(scac, tier, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

#![no_std]

#[no_mangle]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0x8120E9C099B13F94 }

fn ml_fn_commission(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32) -> f64 {
    if (amount < 1000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        return (amount * 0.03f64);
    }
    if (amount < 5000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 2i32; }
        return (amount * 0.05f64);
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 3i32; }
    return (amount * 0.07f64);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_commission(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_commission(amount, tier)
}

fn ml_fn_commission_checked(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    if (amount < 0.0f64) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    if (amount < 1000000.0f64) {
        unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
        return Ok((amount * 0.03f64));
    }
    unsafe { *tier = 3i32; }
    return Ok((amount * 0.07f64));
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_commission_checked(amount: f64, tier: *mut i32, out_value: *mut f64) -> i32 {
    match ml_fn_commission_checked(amount, tier) { Ok(__v) => { unsafe { *out_value = __v; } 0 } Err(__e) => __e }
}

fn ml_fn_count_bounded(n: i32, cap: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut i = 0i32;
    while ((i < n) && (i < cap)) {
        i = (i).wrapping_add(1i32);
    }
    return i;
}
#[no_mangle]

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0xB2B1F335D1DC7105 }

const ML_INTEGRAL: f64 = 9007199254740992.0;
fn ml_trunc_raw(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x != x { return x; }
    if x >= ML_INTEGRAL || x <= -ML_INTEGRAL { return x; }
    (x as i64) as f64
}
// Carry x's sign onto a zero result: IEEE gives a product the XOR of the operand
// signs, so `x * 0.0` is exactly "zero with x's sign". Without this, ceil(-0.5)
// would be +0.0 and C would disagree (DP-R3).
fn ml_sz(r: f64, x: f64) -> f64 { if r == 0.0 { x * 0.0 } else { r } }
fn ml_floor(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t > x { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_ceil(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t < x { t + 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_round(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); if t != t { return t; } let d = x - t; ml_sz(if d >= 0.5 { t + 1.0 } else if d <= -0.5 { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }
fn ml_trunc(x: f64) -> f64 { ml_sz(ml_trunc_raw(x), x) }

fn ml_fn_deduction(gross: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_floor((gross * 0.045f64));
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_deduction(gross: f64) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_deduction(gross)
}

fn ml_fn_fl(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_floor(x);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_fl(x: f64) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_fl(x)
}

fn ml_fn_ce(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_ceil(x);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_ce(x: f64) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_ce(x)
}

fn ml_fn_ro(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_round(x);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_ro(x: f64) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_ro(x)
}

fn ml_fn_tr(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return ml_trunc(x);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_tr(x: f64) -> f64 {
    ml_fn_tr(x)
}

fn ml_fn_check_qty(qty: i32) -> Result<i32, i32> {
    if (qty < 1i32) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    if (qty > 10000i32) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    return Ok(qty);
}

fn ml_fn_safe_div(a: f64, b: f64) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    if (b == 0.0f64) {
        return Err(2);
    }
    return Ok((a / b));
}

fn ml_fn_unit_price(total: f64, qty: i32) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    let q = match ml_fn_check_qty(qty) { Ok(__v) => __v, Err(__e) => return Err(__e) };
    match ml_fn_safe_div(total, (q as f64)) {
        Ok(__v) => {
            return Ok(__v);
        }
        Err(__e) => { return Err(__e); }
    }
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_unit_price(total: f64, qty: i32, out_value: *mut f64) -> i32 {
    match ml_fn_unit_price(total, qty) { Ok(__v) => { unsafe { *out_value = __v; } 0 } Err(__e) => __e }
}

fn ml_fn_line_check(qty: i32, tier: *mut i32) -> Result<i32, i32> {
    let q = match ml_fn_check_qty(qty) { Ok(__v) => __v, Err(__e) => return Err(__e) };
    unsafe { *tier = 1i32; }
    return Ok(q);
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_line_check(qty: i32, tier: *mut i32, out_value: *mut i32) -> i32 {

=== receipt ===

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0x12CC5B502BEA4895 }

fn ml_strout(src: *const u8, buf: *mut u8, cap: i32, needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    // Pass 1: count to the NUL, inclusive. `n` ends at >= 1 for every string.
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) };
        n += 1;
        if b == 0 { break; }
    }
    unsafe { *needed = n; }
    // Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short success (Q12). Nothing has been
    // written, and nothing will be.
    if cap < n { return -1; }
    // Pass 2: copy, terminator included.
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    while i < n {
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = *src.add(i as usize); }
        i += 1;
    }
    0
}

fn ml_slen(src: *const u8) -> i32 {
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        if unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) } == 0 { return n; }
        n += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_ilen(v: i32) -> i32 {
    // Width of the decimal form, sign included. `0` is one digit, not zero.
    let neg = v < 0;
    let mut m: u32 = if neg { (v as u32).wrapping_neg() } else { v as u32 };
    let mut n: i32 = if neg { 2 } else { 1 };
    while m >= 10 { m /= 10; n += 1; }
    n
}

fn ml_wstr(buf: *mut u8, off: i32, src: *const u8) -> i32 {
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(i as usize) };
        if b == 0 { return off + i; }
        unsafe { *buf.add((off + i) as usize) = b; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_wint(buf: *mut u8, off: i32, v: i32) -> i32 {
    // Width comes from ml_ilen, the same function pass 1 used, then the span is
    // filled right-to-left. Two counts that could drift would be a buffer overrun.
    let w = ml_ilen(v);
    let neg = v < 0;
    let mut m: u32 = if neg { (v as u32).wrapping_neg() } else { v as u32 };
    let mut i = off + w;
    loop {
        i -= 1;
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = b'0' + (m % 10) as u8; }
        m /= 10;
        if m == 0 { break; }
    }
    if neg { unsafe { *buf.add((i - 1) as usize) = b'-'; } }
    off + w
}

fn ml_fn_full_name(first: *const u8, last: *const u8, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    let mut __n: i32 = 1;
    __n += ml_slen(last);
    __n += ml_slen(b" \0".as_ptr());
    __n += ml_slen(first);
    unsafe { *ml_needed = __n; }
    if ml_cap < __n { return -1; }
    let mut __o: i32 = 0;
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, last);
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, b" \0".as_ptr());
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, first);
    unsafe { *ml_buf.add(__o as usize) = 0; }
    return 0;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_full_name(first: *const u8, last: *const u8, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_full_name(first, last, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

fn ml_fn_receipt_line(item: *const u8, qty: i32, unit_price: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    let mut __n: i32 = 1;
    __n += ml_slen(item);
    __n += ml_slen(b" x \0".as_ptr());
    __n += ml_ilen(qty);
    __n += ml_slen(b" = \0".as_ptr());
    __n += ml_ilen((qty).wrapping_mul(unit_price));
    unsafe { *ml_needed = __n; }
    if ml_cap < __n { return -1; }
    let mut __o: i32 = 0;
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, item);
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, b" x \0".as_ptr());
    __o = ml_wint(ml_buf, __o, qty);
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, b" = \0".as_ptr());
    __o = ml_wint(ml_buf, __o, (qty).wrapping_mul(unit_price));
    unsafe { *ml_buf.add(__o as usize) = 0; }
    return 0;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_receipt_line(item: *const u8, qty: i32, unit_price: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_receipt_line(item, qty, unit_price, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

fn ml_fn_label(n: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    let mut __n: i32 = 1;
    __n += ml_ilen(n);
    unsafe { *ml_needed = __n; }
    if ml_cap < __n { return -1; }
    let mut __o: i32 = 0;
    __o = ml_wint(ml_buf, __o, n);
    unsafe { *ml_buf.add(__o as usize) = 0; }
    return 0;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_label(n: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_label(n, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

fn ml_fn_summary(count: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    if (count == 0i32) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (count == 1i32) {
        return ml_strout(b"1 item\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
    }
    let mut __n: i32 = 1;
    __n += ml_ilen(count);
    __n += ml_slen(b" items\0".as_ptr());
    unsafe { *ml_needed = __n; }
    if ml_cap < __n { return -1; }
    let mut __o: i32 = 0;
    __o = ml_wint(ml_buf, __o, count);
    __o = ml_wstr(ml_buf, __o, b" items\0".as_ptr());
    unsafe { *ml_buf.add(__o as usize) = 0; }
    return 0;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_summary(count: i32, ml_buf: *mut u8, ml_cap: i32, ml_needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_summary(count, ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed)
}

fn ml_fn_refund(paid: f64, days_since: i32) -> Result<f64, i32> {
    if (paid < 0.0f64) {
        return Err(3);
    }
    if (days_since > 30i32) {
        return Err(4);
    }
    return Ok((paid * 0.9f64));
}

}

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0xEBBDE5676601568D }

fn ml_streq(a: *const u8, b: *const u8) -> bool {
    let mut i = 0usize;
    loop {
        let (x, y) = unsafe { (*a.add(i), *b.add(i)) };
        if x != y { return false; }
        if x == 0 { return true; }
        i += 1;
    }
}

fn ml_strout(src: *const u8, buf: *mut u8, cap: i32, needed: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    // Pass 1: count to the NUL, inclusive. `n` ends at >= 1 for every string.
    let mut n: i32 = 0;
    loop {
        let b = unsafe { *src.add(n as usize) };
        n += 1;
        if b == 0 { break; }
    }
    unsafe { *needed = n; }
    // Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short success (Q12). Nothing has been
    // written, and nothing will be.
    if cap < n { return -1; }
    // Pass 2: copy, terminator included.
    let mut i: i32 = 0;
    while i < n {
        unsafe { *buf.add(i as usize) = *src.add(i as usize); }
        i += 1;
    }
    0
}

const ML_INTEGRAL: f64 = 9007199254740992.0;
fn ml_trunc_raw(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x != x { return x; }
    if x >= ML_INTEGRAL || x <= -ML_INTEGRAL { return x; }
    (x as i64) as f64
}
// Carry x's sign onto a zero result: IEEE gives a product the XOR of the operand
// signs, so `x * 0.0` is exactly "zero with x's sign". Without this, ceil(-0.5)
// would be +0.0 and C would disagree (DP-R3).
fn ml_sz(r: f64, x: f64) -> f64 { if r == 0.0 { x * 0.0 } else { r } }
fn ml_floor(x: f64) -> f64 { let t = ml_trunc_raw(x); ml_sz(if t > x { t - 1.0 } else { t }, x) }

fn ml_fn_is_big(n: i32) -> Result<bool, i32> {
    if (n < 0i32) {
        return Err(1);
    }
    return Ok((n > 100i32));
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_is_big(n: i32, out_value: *mut bool) -> i32 {
    match ml_fn_is_big(n) { Ok(__v) => { unsafe { *out_value = __v; } 0 } Err(__e) => __e }
}

fn ml_fn_span(n: i32, lo: *mut i32, hi: *mut i32) -> i32 {
    unsafe { *lo = (n).wrapping_sub(1i32); }
    unsafe { *hi = (n).wrapping_add(1i32); }
    return n;
}

fn ml_fn_split(x: f64, whole: *mut f64, negative: *mut bool) -> f64 {
    unsafe { *whole = ml_floor(x); }
    unsafe { *negative = (x < 0.0f64); }
    return (x - ml_floor(x));
}

}

fn ml_fn_code_of(s: *const u8) -> Result<i32, i32> {

        return Err(2);

    if ml_streq(s, b"KR\0".as_ptr()) {
        return Ok(82i32);
    }
    return Ok(0i32);
}

    return ml_strout(b"SMALL\0".as_ptr(), ml_buf, ml_cap, ml_needed);
}

// Generated by mlc. Do not edit.
#![no_std]
#![allow(unused_parens)]
#![allow(unused_mut)]

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_module_abi_version() -> u32 { 1 }

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ml_iface_hash() -> u64 { 0xD3FC526CA957505A }

fn ml_fn_sum_to(n: i32) -> i32 {
    let mut total = 0i32;
    let mut i = 1i32;
    while (i <= n) {
        total = (total).wrapping_add(i);
        i = (i).wrapping_add(1i32);
    }
    return total;
}
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn mlx_sum_to(n: i32) -> i32 {
    ml_fn_sum_to(n)
}
